description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named CategoryPreviewAdapter for displaying products in a list, handling item differences efficiently, and managing user interactions such as adding to cart, incrementing, and decrementing product quantities.

classes.name: CategoryPreviewAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for binding Product data to RecyclerView items, facilitating user interactions related to cart operations.

classes.name: CategoryPreviewAdapter.ProductViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds Product data to the item layout and sets up interaction handlers.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ProductViewHolder with inflated item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds Product data to the ViewHolder and sets up UI updates and animations.
